notConfigured.title: TaskMaster is not set up here
notConfigured.description: TaskMaster breaks a project into tasks an agent can pick up one at a time.

features.aiPowered: Breaks a large piece of work into tasks small enough to finish.
features.prdTemplates: Turns a written brief into that list of tasks.
features.dependencyTracking: Keeps track of which task waits on which.
features.progressVisualization: Shows the whole board and how far along each task is.
features.cliIntegration: Runs from the terminal too, with the same tasks.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started with TaskMaster
gettingStarted.subtitle: TaskMaster is set up. Here is what to do next.

createPRD.title: Write a brief
createPRD.description: Describe what you want built. This is the document TaskMaster reads.

generateTasks.title: Turn the brief into tasks
generateTasks.description: Ask your agent to read the brief. TaskMaster breaks it into tasks with the detail needed to build each one.

analyzeTasks.title: Break the big ones down
analyzeTasks.description: Ask your agent which tasks look large, and to split those into subtasks.

startBuilding.title: Start building
startBuilding.description: Ask your agent to pick up a task, and to keep the board up to date as the work goes.

gettingStarted.tip: Start with a brief — it is what everything else is generated from.

proTips.title: Worth knowing
proTips.search: The search box finds a task by anything written on it.
proTips.views: The board, list and grid show the same tasks three ways.
proTips.filters: Filters narrow the board to one status or one priority.
proTips.details: Clicking a task opens it in full, subtasks and all.

learnMore.title: Learn more
learnMore.description: TaskMaster is an open project. Its documentation, examples and source are on GitHub.

noMatchingTasks.description: Try a different search, or clear the filters.
